[attribute-count]
=== `@count` Count

Number of specific objects that appear in the document.

#### Usage/Remarks
This attribute holds the number of objects being counted. The _type_ of objects being counted is indicated in one of two different ways, depending on what is being counted. For the precombined count elements (e.g., <<element-fig-count,`<fig-count>`>>, <<element-word-count,`<word-count>`>>, etc.) the element name on which this attribute occurs indicates what is being counted (figures, words, etc.). For non-precombined counted objects, for example, the number of related standards or non-normative references, the <<attribute-count-type,`@count-type`>> attribute names what is being counted.

#### REQUIRED on many elements; click for list and usage

<<element-count,`<count>`>>, <<element-equation-count,`<equation-count>`>>, <<element-fig-count,`<fig-count>`>>, <<element-page-count,`<page-count>`>>, <<element-ref-count,`<ref-count>`>>, <<element-table-count,`<table-count>`>>, <<element-word-count,`<word-count>`>>
|===
| Value| Meaning

| Counting number| The number of objects being counted, for example, “`5`” for five tables or five figures.
| Restriction| This attribute is required; it must be provided if the element is used.
|===

#### Tagged Samples

#### How many of each element for precombined counting elements

[source,xml]
....
...
<std-meta>
 ...
 <counts>
  <fig-count count="1"/>
  <table-count count="7"/>
  <equation-count count="141"/>
  <ref-count count="163"/>
  <page-count count="151"/>
 </counts>
</std-meta>
...
....
#### How many of each element for both precombined and bespoke (`<count>`) counting elements

[source,xml]
....
...
<counts>
 <count count-type="norm-ref" count="61"/>
 <count count-type="biblio-ref" count="102"/>
 <fig-count count="3"/>
 <table-count count="2"/>
 <equation-count count="0"/>
 <ref-count count="163"/>
 <page-count count="67"/>
</counts>
...
